title: Sheet
api:
interface SheetProps {
  trigger?: ReactElement
  title: string
  description?: string
  children?: ReactNode
  footer?: ReactNode
  open?: boolean
  defaultOpen?: boolean
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void
  side?: 'left' | 'right' | 'bottom'
  className?: string
  initialFocus?: ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof BaseDialog.Popup>['initialFocus']
  finalFocus?: ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof BaseDialog.Popup>['finalFocus']
}

function Sheet({
  trigger,
  title,
  description,
  children,
  footer,
  open,
  defaultOpen,
  onOpenChange,
  side = 'right',
  className,
  initialFocus,
  finalFocus,
}: SheetProps);
